#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int INF = (int)1e8;

// Iterative segment tree (point update, range min query)
struct SegTree {
    int size;
    vector<int> tree;

    SegTree(int n) {
        size = 1;
        while (size < n + 1) size <<= 1;
        tree.assign(2 * size, INF);
    }

    void set(int pos, int val) {
        pos += size;
        tree[pos] = val;
        pos >>= 1;
        while (pos) {
            tree[pos] = min(tree[pos << 1], tree[(pos << 1) | 1]);
            pos >>= 1;
        }
    }

    int query(int l, int r) const {
        if (l > r) return INF;
        l += size;
        r += size;
        int res = INF;
        while (l <= r) {
            if (l & 1) {
                res = min(res, tree[l]);
                l++;
            }
            if (!(r & 1)) {
                res = min(res, tree[r]);
                r--;
            }
            l >>= 1;
            r >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }
};

int main() {
    int n, k;
    scanf("%d %d", &n, &k);

    // intervals[0] is {0,0} by default (zero-initialized)
    vector<vector<int>> intervals(k + 2, vector<int>(2, 0));
    for (int i = 1; i <= k; ++i) {
        scanf("%d %d", &intervals[i][0], &intervals[i][1]);
    }
    intervals[k + 1][0] = 2 * n;
    intervals[k + 1][1] = 2 * n;
    k++; // now k = original k + 1

    SegTree tree0(n), tree1(n);
    tree0.set(0, 0); // dp[0] = 0

    vector<int> data(n + 1);

    for (int i = 1; i <= k; ++i) {
        int intervalLength = intervals[i][1] - intervals[i][0];
        int middleLength = intervals[i][0] - intervals[i - 1][1];

        // toArray from tree0
        for (int j = 0; j <= n; ++j) {
            data[j] = tree0.query(j, j);
        }

        // shift data right by (intervalLength + middleLength) and fill left with INF
        int shift = intervalLength + middleLength;
        int copyLen = max(0, n + 1 - shift);
        if (copyLen > 0) {
            // move elements from index 0 to index shift
            for (int j = n; j >= shift; --j) {
                data[j] = data[j - shift];
            }
        }
        fill(data.begin(), data.begin() + min(n + 1, shift), INF);

        int minX = intervals[i][1] - middleLength - intervalLength;
        int maxX = intervals[i][1] - middleLength;
        for (int j = 0; j <= n; ++j) {
            int minNeedTime = tree0.query(minX - j, maxX - j);
            data[j] = min(data[j], minNeedTime + 1);
        }

        for (int j = 0; j <= n; ++j) {
            int minNeedTime = tree0.query(j - middleLength - intervalLength, j - middleLength);
            data[j] = min(data[j], minNeedTime + 2);
        }

        // fromArray to tree1
        for (int j = 0; j <= n; ++j) {
            tree1.set(j, data[j]);
        }

        // Swap trees
        swap(tree0, tree1);
    }

    int minFlipTime = tree0.query(n, n);
    if (minFlipTime < INF) {
        printf("Full\n%d\n", minFlipTime);
    } else {
        printf("Hungry\n");
    }

    return 0;
}
